in_sanskrit.name: Minti
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Intelligent, delicate
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Minti एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘मिन्ती’ (Minti), which means ‘intelligent’ and ‘delicate’. In Hindu mythology, Minti is a rare female name associated with the goddess of knowledge and wisdom, Saraswati.
